{{Top|leg}}
An '''environment underlay''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement that provided heavy-duty resistance to fire and cold damage. The Mark I, II, III, IV, & V versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', this upgrade can be used with all types of armor and robes.
